description: Stop physical token movement from producing automatic Boost, Overcharge, or excess-movement notifications while preserving movement tracking and UI presentation.
planning_goal: Horizontal and elevation token movement must continue to be measured, recorded, and reflected in Frame Conn movement UI, but physical movement must not warn about exceeding the legal allowance and must not report or imply automatic Boost or Overcharge action use. Existing measurement-failure warnings and the informational elevation-recorded message remain unchanged.
